source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:10 (the Ramah; the Masorah; the Zohar; Bachya)
claim_en: ad ki yavo SHILO ('until SHILOH comes' — the scepter clause): the most argued word in the testament, carried WHOLE — the WRITTEN form שילה with the yod AND the final he, exactly as the Ramah rules ('full yod, and it takes a he at the word's end'), as the Masorah counts, and as the Zohar reads it (yod-he); the READ form שילו with the vav — both forms unique in the Torah and both checked in-stream; MS calls the printed midrash-glosses that read it lean 'among the most astonishing errors,' and corrects the printed Masorah's own note (the true full-shilu stations are in Judges 21:21 and Jeremiah 7:12, named); Bachya (in his teacher's name) reads the accent on AD ('forever') as separating it from the coming — Onkelos' 'until Messiah comes' named; the counts (Shiloh = Messiah; = Moses, the Zohar's folio) named: the crux carried with every reading on file, the stream's letters checked.

source: the stream's own census on Gen 49:18 (the readings named)
claim_en: li-yshuatkha QIVITI YHWH ('For Your salvation I wait, O LORD'): the three-word cry — no mid-verse pause mark, the shortest verse of the testament — carries the LAST four-letter Name in the book of Genesis: the stream's own census finds NO Name-token after it, and only this one after the Potiphar span (39:23) — the Name that saturated the beginnings withdraws through the Joseph cycle and exits the book in the dying father's one interjection (asserted from the stream; the station checked); the readings hear Samson's serpent-rider fall and the cry between Dan's verses (named): the axis-verse of the poem.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:9 (the accents as arbiters; Sanhedrin and Tosafot named)
claim_en: mi-TEREF beni alita ('from the prey, my son, you went up'): MS settles the old debate (the Sanhedrin page on Judah and the blessing; Tosafot reading the Tamar confession — 'you lifted YOURSELF from the death-verdict'; Rashi and Ibn Ezra binding beni to alita) BY THE MARKS THEMSELVES: 'mi-teref carries the tifcha, WHICH DIVIDES; beni carries the connector, which does not' — the divider checked in-stream on the prey-word; and MS names the connector THE GALGAL (the rolling stroke) where SNAPSHOT writes the MUNACH: the run's SECOND galgal-vs-munach station (47:26 its twin) — the mark-split carried named, both strokes checked; the accents arbitrate the sentence: the son is bound to his rising, not to the prey.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:11 (the Ramah's exception-rule; the midrash named)
claim_en: osri la-gefen IRO... suto ('binding his FOAL to the vine... his GARMENT in the blood of grapes'): the vine-verse carries TWO written/read pairs — עירה and סותה both WRITTEN with the final he and READ with the vav (both pairs checked in-stream as their two tokens; the verse counts fourteen) — and the Ramah's rule marks the foal-word the Torah's EXCEPTION: every other word of its class is full with a final vav; this one alone full yod with the he; the midrash-chain reads the he as the city ('he shall bind Israel, the vine, to HIS CITY — Jerusalem'; the Yefe Toar and the readings named): the exception-letter carrying the city.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:13 (the Masorah's nine; Nehemiah named)
claim_en: ve-yarkhato AL tzidon ('and his flank UPON Sidon'): one of the Masorah's NINE presumed-until (sevirin) stations — readers presume AD ('unto Sidon'), the letter writes AL ('upon') and the Masorah locks it (MS pointing to the Nehemiah station for the file): the presumption-class of gen_69's four presumed-singulars gains its until-file — the letter checked in-stream against the reader's ear.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:21 (the Hilleli; the Ramah's mnemonic)
claim_en: ayala SHELUCHA ('a hind SENT FORTH' — Naphtali): LEAN in the Hilleli and all the books — and the Ramah's mnemonic seals the pair: 'one full and one lean — NAPHTALI'S is lean, ESAU'S is full': the census verifies EXACT — the full form stands ONCE in the whole Torah, at Esau's PRESENT (32:19, 'a present SENT to my lord'), and the hind runs lean (asserted): the gift-word fattened for the appeaser, thinned for the runner; Deborah's war and song named by the Kitzur (the hind = the ten thousand of Naphtali; the fair sayings = the Song, by count).

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:21 (his own collation; the Ramah found after)
claim_en: ha-NOTEN imre shafer ('who GIVES fair sayings'): the printed Masorah counts FIVE full giver-tokens and MS overrules it from the accurate books and manuscript Masorah-lists — FOUR full, ALL beyond the Torah (in the Psalms, named) — 'and my heart REJOICED in all my toil' (his own words) when he found the Ramah had ruled it before him: 'every giver-form in the Torah is written lean' — and the stream verifies the rule WHOLE: ZERO full giver-tokens in the Torah (the empty census checked), the lean pair standing at the hind's sayings and at 'who GIVES you strength' (Deut 8:18, from the stream): a scholar's joy, verified.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:3 (the Masorah's stressed pair; the stream's own pair)
claim_en: reuven BEKHORI ata ('Reuben, MY FIRSTBORN are you'): the my-firstborn word stands exactly TWICE in the Torah — Reuben's REVOKED one here and the NATION'S at the burning bush charge ('my son, my FIRSTBORN, Israel', Exod 4:22 — armed): the title stripped from the man is already the people's (census checked); and the Masorah's own pair is by STRESS — two fore-stressed my-firstborns: Reuben's and EPHRAIM'S ('Ephraim is my firstborn', Jer 31:9, named beyond the stream — the very son the crossed hands just installed): the fore-stress checked in-stream (the connector on the first syllable).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 49:6 (the Masorah's pair; Isaiah named)
claim_en: bi-qhalam al TECHAD kevodi ('with their assembly let my honor not UNITE'): the unite-word's ONE Torah token (checked) — and its Scripture-partner is the tyrant of Isaiah, DENIED the union: 'you shall not UNITE with them in burial' (Isa 14:20, named): Jacob refuses the union of his honor with the plotters' assembly (the Kitzur: Korach's — that his name not be reckoned there even after death, and on the singers' rolls it is reckoned, named); the refused union and the denied one on one skeleton.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:6/15/26 (the maqqef rulings; the Scripture-three named)
claim_en: The maqqef file — MS rules three joinings 'with the maqqef, not with the lengthening-stroke,' and the stream writes ALL THREE: iqru-SHOR ('they hamstrung an ox', 49:6), le-mas-OVED ('a toiling serf', 49:15 — checked), ad-TAAVAT ('unto the desire of the everlasting hills', 49:26 — asserted): three hyphens ruled and found; and the serf-phrase's Scripture-three named by the Kitzur (Joshua's unexpelled Canaanites, Solomon's levy — Josh 16:10, 1 Kgs 9:21): Issachar's shoulder under the Torah's own hyphen.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:27 (the Hilleli; the Masorah's seventeen)
claim_en: BINYAMIN zeev yitraf ('BENJAMIN is a wolf that tears'): written FULL in the Hilleli and all the books — one of the Masorah's SEVENTEEN full Benjamins in Scripture (named) — and the stream's Torah-census closes the corpus's running file: SEVEN full Benjamins in the Torah, the naming (35:18), the not-sent (42:4), the prayer, the seeing, the greeted, the mouth-witness (45:12 — gen_68's sixth), and LAST the wolf-blessing (checked with all seven refs): the full spelling's Torah career ends at the tribe's own verse; the register-head lean (46:21, the census law) stands beside it — full for the person, lean at the muster.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 49:10/11/12/17/22/23/26/29 (the file; Or Torah)
claim_en: The pointing file: YIQHAT amim ('the obedience of peoples', 49:10) and IQVE sus ('the heels of a horse', 49:17) each with the qof DAGESHED 'FOR SPLENDOR' (MS's own term — a dagesh set for beauty, not grammar: the letters dressed for the poem; checked and asserted); KIBES ('he washes', 49:11) — most books point the bet SEGOL, Or Torah rules TSERE, and the stream writes the TSERE: with Or Torah against the many (checked); PORAT ('fruitful', 49:22) with the resh in QAMATS both times (most books, old prints, Or Torah); TIHYENA ('they shall be', 49:26) nun in QAMATS; NEESAF ('being gathered', 49:29) samekh in QAMATS per the Masorah (the Isaiah station named; asserted); the front-stroke on the alef of el ha-meara ('to the cave', 49:29), not on the he; VA-YEMARARUHU ('and they embittered him', 49:23) LEAN with the midrash's own lean-reading named; and CHAKHLILI ('darkened [eyes]', 49:12) — MS REJECTS the large-chet claim: absent from every manuscript and early print, absent from the printed Masorah's own large-letter list — a rejected crown carried as a rejection (named).

The testament's number-crowns, carried NAMED-ONLY (letter-arithmetic and scroll-layout, not stream-marks): the hidden end — the sons answer that the letters of SIN do not appear in their names, and Jacob answers that neither do the letters of THE END (the concealment explained by the alphabet itself); the assembly-word holding the SIX words of the Shema ('Hear, O Israel' spoken to the father Israel, named); JUDAH'S verse (49:8) as a fixed COLUMN-HEAD of the Torah scroll — the yod of the six head-letters (with Bereshit's bet, the sea's he, the shin, the mem, the vav — the scribes' six, named: scroll layout, not stream); the David acrostics (the lion-whelp's initials; Dan 'as ONE of the tribes' = as David); ben PORAT = Manasseh-and-Ephraim by count (and 'the interpreting son' by sound-play); and THE SUN AND THE MOON: the initials following each son's name sum to 345 — the days of the SOLAR year — and the final letters of the blessings to 354 — the days of the LUNAR year — sealed by Jeremiah's covenant ('if these laws depart from before Me, the seed of Israel too shall cease', named): the twelve blessings counted against the two clocks; Dan-before-Gad here against Moses' Gad-before-Dan (buried in Gad's plot, named); and the VE-ZOT inclusio — the testament closes with the word Moses' blessing will open (Deut 33:1, armed): the stations checked, the arithmetic named.
